quote: Where the signal is a green straight-through arrow alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed straight through, but must not turn right or left. Such vehicular traffic must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk at the time the signal is exhibited.

activation.condition: Ego faces a sole green straight-through arrow at the signalized intersection

obligation.description: Traffic proceeding straight must yield to vehicles and pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or adjacent crosswalk; right and left turns are prohibited while this sole arrow governs.

timing.description: While the sole green straight-through arrow is exhibited and before entering the conflict area.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Legal status of another vehicle or pedestrian requires independent source review and rule composition.
